subject.title: fix(gateway): stop showing retired HEARTBEAT.md in the agent files editor

question: Should OpenClaw now reject the deprecated `agents.files.set` workflow for `HEARTBEAT.md`, rather than retaining a no-op editable legacy file?
rationale: The implementation is internally consistent and real proof shows the runtime already ignores the file, but rejecting an established gateway write request is an intentional compatibility boundary that should be explicitly accepted under the protected maintainer label.

options.title: Accept the retirement boundary
options.body: Merge the cleanup and document cron scratch plus `openclaw doctor --fix` as the only supported heartbeat-instruction and legacy-migration paths.

options.title: Keep a temporary deprecated write path
options.body: Retain a documented no-op or migration-oriented gateway behavior until maintainers choose a deprecation cutoff, accepting continued UI/API drift.

recommendation.title: Accept the retirement boundary
recommendation.body: Merge the cleanup and document cron scratch plus `openclaw doctor --fix` as the only supported heartbeat-instruction and legacy-migration paths.

likelyOwner.reason: This person carried the merged cron-scratch migration and its legacy-runtime cleanup, and authored the remaining-surface alignment.
